about_the_game:
You play the role of Elie, 16 years old. A teenager with no story, curious, a bit of a dreamer, a fan of video games and board games. He loves spending his afternoons playing role-playing games with his two best friends, Gab and Medie.

He lives in Sector G with his mother and little sister. His little sister can be a bit of a handful, but at this age, that's only to be expected.

The world around Elie seems ordinary. People go to work, deal with their daily worries... In short, everything is normal. Until one day someone contacts you. A strange person who tells you one thing: “you're the only one who can change the course of things”.

But why you? And above all... are you ready to trust them?

Pluralys is a world that is both familiar and profoundly strange. Here you will encounter beings from elsewhere, living among humans.

What do we still have to find out about them? Do they intend to settle on your planet forever?

In this adventure, you'll never really be alone. Your links with Gab, Medie and other characters will be at the heart of the story. Support them, talk to them...

You've been entrusted with a mysterious object. Thanks to it, you'll be able to see and interact with the world in a whole new way.

Everyone in Pluralys has something to say. But you'll have to make some important decisions, because the choices are all yours! Be curious and discover the people who live in this world.

short_description: Pluralys is an RPG focused on comedy, exploration, and intrigue. You play as Elie, a young and innocent boy living a peaceful life—until unexpected visitors arrive and change everything. What seems like a quiet, cozy story hides deeper mysteries to uncover and secret plots waiting to be exposed.
